title: A version made by a design names its design task: trigger kind design
why: Since migration 0040 (and 0041), publishing a designed HTML page makes a new version of the report whose trigger names the design task that made it, with kind design. A11 declared the trigger before designs existed, as research or rendition only, so every strict reader of the report's versions refused the whole list once a design was published: the report pane said it could not be loaded, and the project snapshot, which carries each report's current version, was refused the same way (FND-B-HTML-READ-CONTRACT-FIX-01).

The trigger's kind now includes design. Nothing else in the trigger changes: kind and taskId stay required, any other kind is still refused, and the trigger keeps no property beyond the four it declares (the design task's own record stays where it was, read from its task).

patch.value: What produced this version: a research task, a rendition of the task's report (Try PDF again, with its render job), or a design task that published the report's designed HTML page (taskId names the design task). Omitted when unknown.
